source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A billing-related feature primarily, with limited connection to clinical decision-making at the point of care","B":"A mandatory override that removes the nurse's own clinical judgment from the ordering process entirely","C":"Clinical decision support, designed to provide relevant, timely information to support safe clinical decision-making","D":"A system feature generally considered to add little practical clinical value during order entry"}}
source_row.rationale: Clinical decision support systems, such as drug interaction alerts, are designed to provide relevant, timely information at the point of care to support safe clinical decision-making, though clinical judgment remains essential.
source_row.source_detail: Purpose of Clinical Decision Support Systems
source_row.source_name: ONC — Health IT Clinical Decision Support
